message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts: illegal cultivation of poppy (罂粟) with opiate alkaloids. In Chinese criminal law, cultivation of poppy for opium is a crime of "非法种植罂粟" which falls under "走私、贩卖、运输、制造毒品罪" or specifically "非法种植罂粟罪". The law: Article 347 of Criminal Law: "非法种植罂粟的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So the crime is "非法种植罂粟罪" which is part of "非法种植罂粟罪" (cultivation of poppy). In the dataset, they often label as "非法种植罂粟" or "非法种植罂粟罪". The examples: they gave "走私珍贵动物、珍贵动物制品" etc. For poppy, likely "非法种植罂粟". Could also be "制造毒品" but they didn't process the poppy into opium, just cultivated. So the appropriate charge: "非法种植罂粟". In Chinese classification, maybe "非法种植罂粟罪". So answer: [罪名]非法种植罂粟<eoa>
